title: 三翼回転式エントランスドア
description: 三枚の放射状ドア、対向する二つの開口を持つ曲面ドラム、環状ヘッダー、上部軸受支持、床軸受、両面押し棒、ブラシシールを備えた入口アセンブリ。青い面は不透明な単色PBRで、透過ガラスではありません。建物や床は含みません。静的な固定姿勢で、回転動作・自動制御・挟み込み保護や安全規格への適合は未実装・未検証です。接地配置原点と回転機構用の支点は別で、独立した可動ピボットはありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.826 × 2.644 × 2.826 m、31,756三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: Entrance assembly with three radial door wings, two opposing access openings in a segmented curved drum, annular header, supported upper bearing, floor bearing, two-sided push rails and brush seals. Blue surfaces are opaque constant-color PBR glazing substitutes, not transparent glass. No building or floor is included. Fixed static pose with no rotation, automatic controls or entrapment protection, and no safety-compliance validation. The ground placement origin is not a supplied articulation pivot; moving parts are not separately rigged. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.826 × 2.644 × 2.826 m; 31,756 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
